noun_definition: Checkmark box refers to the graphical element used to indicate task completion, which is expected to align horizontally with the task title when the font size is larger.
Task title refers to the text label associated with a task that is created in the chat interface, which should align with the checkmark box when the font size is larger.
Font size refers to the size of the text displayed on the device, which affects the alignment of the checkmark box relative to the task title in the user interface.
